# Verde pe bune — published site

This repository holds only the built static website **Verde pe bune** (green space and tree canopy in
Bucharest), served by GitHub Pages: https://gabrieln2805.github.io/verdepebune/

**Generated — do not edit.** Every file here is built from a private working repository and is replaced on each
deploy. Corrections and questions: use the contact on the site's "Despre" page.

## Licences

- Code (HTML, CSS, JavaScript written for this site): MIT.
- Data files in `data/`: each file states its licence in its `meta` block and in `data/manifest.json`
  (CC BY 4.0 for the canopy and definitions files; ODbL 1.0 for files derived from OpenStreetMap).
- Basemap `data/*.pmtiles`: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright).
- Fonts (`fonts/`) and map glyphs (`map/glyphs/`): SIL Open Font License 1.1 (licence files next to them).
- Third-party libraries in `vendor/`: their own licences, next to each file.
